APP_TITLE: Ikigo cy'Uburezi cy'Abapayiniya ba Afurika - Hanze
WELCOME_SUB: Irembo ryo Guhesha Agaciro Afurika binyuze muri Pi Ecosystem
AFRICA_DAY: (Mu kwizihiza Umunsi wa 25 wa Afurika, iyi porogaramu yo guhugura Abapayiniya ba Pi yatangijwe)
INTRO_P1: Pi Network ni umushinga w'ifaranga rya dijitali n'ibidukikije by'isi yose wagenewe gutuma cryptocurrency igera kuri buri wese kandi igirire akamaro.
INTRO_P2: Bitandukanye na cryptocurrency gakondo akenshi ikenera imashini zihenze zo gucukura n'amashanyarazi menshi, Pi Network ituma abantu basanzwe bitabira ako kanya kuri telefoni zabo.
INTRO_P3: Icyerekezo cya Pi Network ni ukubaka ibidukikije biyoborwa n'abantu aho ifaranga rya dijitali rishobora gukoreshwa mu bikorwa nyabyo, serivisi nyazo, imiryango nyayo n'uruhare nyarwo mu bukungu.
M2: Guha imbaraga abantu basanzwe kwisi yose
M4: Gushyigikira ubucuruzi bwa muntu ku muntu
CH1_SUB: Murakaza neza mu Kigo cy'Uburezi cy'Abapayiniya ba Afurika - Hanze. Uru rubuga rwashinzwe kugirango rwigishe, ruhe imbaraga kandi rutegure Abapayiniya bo muri Afurika n'ubucuruzi kugirango bitabire neza muri Pi Ecosystem.
REG2: Iyandikishe ukoresheje Facebook cyangwa Numero ya Telefoni
DAILY_MINING: Ubucukuzi bwa buri munsi: Garuka buri masaha 24 kugirango ukomeze gucukura.
WALLET_SEC: Umutekano wa Wallet: Ntuzigere usangira amagambo 24 ya Passphrase yawe. Ufite amagambo ayo ni we nyir'ubwite wa wallet.
CH2_TITLE: IGICE CYA 2 — UBUREZI BWA PI WALLET
CH2_DESC: Wige uburyo bwo kwakira no kohereza Pi mu mutekano ukoresheje Pi Wallet muri Pi Browser.
CH2A_TITLE: IGICE CYA 2A — AMAHUGURWA Y'IBIKORWA YA PI WALLET
CH2A_DESC: Tangirana n'amafaranga make yo kugerageza, genzura aderesi, ntuzigere usangira passphrase yawe.
CH3_DESC: Pi Browser DApps ni application zidakorerwaho n'umuntu umwe zigamije ikoreshwa nyaryo.
CH4_TITLE: IGICE CYA 4 — MAPOFPI & KWISHYIRA HAMWE KW'UBUCURUZI
CH4_DESC: Menya ubucuruzi bwemera Pi kwisi yose.
CH5_DESC: Global Consensus Value itera inkunga ikoreshwa nyaryo muri ecosystem.
CH6_DESC: Wige igitabo cya Doris Yin cyerekeranye no guhanga ikoreshwa no gukura kwa ecosystem.
MERCHANT_DESC: Uburyo bwo kwinjira muri ecosystem, gushyira ubucuruzi bwawe kuri MapOfPi, kwemera kwishyura Pi.
FINAL_P: Afurika ifite amahirwe yo kuba imwe mu turere dukomeye mu ikoreshwa rifatika muri Pi Ecosystem. Hamwe Turubaka. Hamwe Turigisha. Hamwe Duha Agaciro Afurika binyuze muri Pi.
